content.short: Unchained is a no-hype crypto news site with news, educational articles, informational podcasts and videos.
content.description: Unchained delivers crypto news and analysis with a no-hype approach, spanning timely reporting, educational articles, expert interviews, and multimedia content such as podcasts and videos. It was founded by Laura Shin, the author of The Cryptopians and a former senior editor at Forbes, and it extends the themes of her long-running podcast, Unchained, which first launched in 2016. The site aims to illuminate blockchain developments, interview industry leaders, and provide accessible context for readers seeking deeper understanding of the crypto landscape.
